items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So you and Bobby Hackett -- well, you were on the sessions and Bobby Hackett. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, yeah, I was right there.

ctx.x: No, I won't, uh-huh, not what I'm thinking, which is all right. Yeah, I worked a lot for Mitch Miller. Just name them all, they all were engineers, like, and directors for the date. Jackie Gleason, everything he made, I was on it. All his records. Fortunately, I have them Silk and Shookin' Brass and all of them.
So you and Bobby Hackett -- well, you were on the sessions and Bobby Hackett.
Yeah, yeah, I was right there.
